14.12.title: GPS Receiver Maximum Allowable Amplifier Noise Figure
14.12.title_cn: GPS接收机最大允许放大器噪声系数
14.12.description: Consider the GPS receiver system shown below. The guaranteed minimum L1 (1575 MHz) carrier power received by an antenna on Earth having a gain of 0 dB is $S_i = -160$ dBW. A GPS receiver is usually specified as requiring a minimum carrier-to-noise ratio, relative to a 1 Hz bandwidth, of $C/N$ (Hz). If the receiver antenna actually has a gain $G_A$ and a noise temperature $T_A$, derive an expression for the maximum allowable amplifier noise figure $F$, assuming an amplifier gain $G$ and a connecting line loss $L$. Evaluate this expression for $C/N = 32$ dB-Hz, $G_A = 5$ dB, $T_A = 300$ K, $G = 10$ dB, and $L = 25$ dB.
14.12.description_cn: 考虑下图所示的 GPS 接收机系统。地球上增益为 0 dB 的天线接收到的保证最小 L1（1575 MHz）载波功率为 $S_i = -160$ dBW。GPS 接收机通常规定相对于 1 Hz 带宽的最小载噪比为 $C/N$ (Hz)。若接收天线实际具有增益 $G_A$ 和噪声温度 $T_A$，假设放大器增益为 $G$、连接线损耗为 $L$，推导最大允许放大器噪声系数 $F$ 的表达式。并对 $C/N = 32$ dB-Hz，$G_A = 5$ dB，$T_A = 300$ K，$G = 10$ dB，$L = 25$ dB 进行计算。

14.12.conclusion: The computed F is negative, which is physically impossible (F ≥ 1). This indicates that with the given parameters (particularly large line loss L = 25 dB), the required C/N0 cannot be achieved even with a noiseless amplifier (F=1).
14.12.conclusion_cn: 计算得到的 F 为负值，物理上不可能（F ≥ 1）。这表明在给定参数下（尤其是线损 L = 25 dB 过大），即使使用无噪声放大器（F=1）也无法达到所需的 C/N0。
